integrity: Self-contained exact kernel-row proof with reproducible rational checks. Finite checker does not certify the infinite parameter ranges. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform leaf probabilities, common integer branching factor at every split, and alternating depth-only signs are essential assumptions; no claim covers general martingale-transform multipliers or infinite-filtration boundedness. Early priority is subject to specialist literature not fully indexed.
title: Exact endpoint growth of the alternating-level martingale transform on regular trees
